project: Project Rahul — Family 2D Pixel-Art Fighting Game

global_specs.vfx_palette: Warm physical kinetic force — warm-white (#FFF5D6), amber (#FFB030), orange (#FF6A1A), grey-brown dust & debris

assets.gameplay_purpose: Charge-up phase for Rahul's Iron Fist power punch; communicates physical coiling and weight loading into the rear striking arm.
assets.start_pose_notes: F1: Standard standing fighting guard matching Batch 1 Idle F1.
assets.recovery_or_end_pose_notes: F6: Stable coiled maximum-charge stance with rear fist clenched tightly at hip/rib and subtle amber-white compressed air spark.
assets.cross_batch_transition_notes: Enters from Batch 1 Standing Guard / Idle F1; F6 transitions directly into Iron Fist Release F1.

assets.gameplay_purpose: Devastating close-to-mid-range physical power punch unleashing stored Iron Fist torque.
assets.start_pose_notes: F1: Coiled Iron Fist stance connecting from Charge F6.
assets.recovery_or_end_pose_notes: F5: Controlled recoil follow-through transitioning into Special Move Recovery or Idle.
assets.cross_batch_transition_notes: Receives Iron Fist Charge F6; F4 triggers Iron Fist Impact VFX (#32); F5 connects into Special Move Recovery (#37) or Batch 1 Standing Guard.

assets.gameplay_purpose: Layered physical kinetic shockwave burst spawned at the fist impact point on Iron Fist contact.
assets.start_pose_notes: F1: Small concentrated warm-white and amber impact flash.
assets.recovery_or_end_pose_notes: F8: Final dissipating dust wisps and tiny kinetic sparks.
assets.cross_batch_transition_notes: Triggered as a separate transparent layer on rahul_31_iron_fist_release F4 at offset (+108, -146) from Rahul's ground pivot.

assets.gameplay_purpose: Explosive gap-closing shoulder-first rush tackle using Rahul's muscular legs and core momentum.
assets.start_pose_notes: F1: Standard standing fighting guard matching Batch 1 Idle F1.
assets.recovery_or_end_pose_notes: F8: Stabilized recovery directly back into Batch 1 standing fighting guard following F6 shoulder impact and F7 hard braking.
assets.cross_batch_transition_notes: Self-contained special move: enters from Batch 1 Standing Guard and returns directly to Standing Guard on F8 (no external recovery required).

assets.gameplay_purpose: Ultimate activation cinematic startup showing Rahul planting wide, cracking the floor under his feet, and hoisting both clenched fists overhead.
assets.start_pose_notes: F1: Commanding wide ultimate activation stance compatible with Batch 1 Standing Guard.
assets.recovery_or_end_pose_notes: F8: Fully prepared overhead double-fist stance ready to slam violently downward.
assets.cross_batch_transition_notes: Enters from Batch 1 Standing Guard; F8 connects directly into Limit Breaker Main Attack (#35) F1.

assets.gameplay_purpose: Rahul's signature ultimate double-fist ground smash unleashing a massive rightward ground-level kinetic shockwave.
assets.start_pose_notes: F1: Exact overhead double-fist stance matching Limit Breaker Activation F8.
assets.recovery_or_end_pose_notes: F8: Lifting torso from ground smash into post-ultimate finishing posture.
assets.cross_batch_transition_notes: Receives Activation F8; triggers Ground Shockwave VFX (#35b) on F5/F6 impact; F8 connects into Limit Breaker Finisher (#36) F1.

vfx_trigger_frame.notes: Triggering #35b on F5 starts its F1 initial floor crack right as Rahul slams down into F6 peak ground contact.

assets.gameplay_purpose: Separately layerable ground-level kinetic shockwave, cracked earth, and rock-debris surge traveling rightward along the arena floor.
assets.start_pose_notes: F1: Concentrated floor crack and warm-white impact flash on Y=272.
assets.recovery_or_end_pose_notes: F8: Final fading low dust wisps along the floor.
assets.cross_batch_transition_notes: Spawned on rahul_35_limit_breaker_main_attack F5 at ground offset (+96, 0) from Rahul's pivot; game engine may translate horizontally right during F3–F6.

assets.gameplay_purpose: Commanding post-ultimate aftermath rising from the ground smash into a holdable confident fighter stance.
assets.start_pose_notes: F1: Low post-smash stance with fists lowered matching Main Attack F8.
assets.recovery_or_end_pose_notes: F4: Squared-shoulder, clenched-fist commanding hold pose (no bodybuilding flex).
assets.cross_batch_transition_notes: Receives Limit Breaker Main Attack F8; F4 connects directly into Special Move Recovery (#37) F1.

assets.gameplay_purpose: Shared post-special recovery returning Rahul naturally from heavy exertion back to his neutral standing fighting guard.
assets.start_pose_notes: F1: Post-special squared stance with clenched fists low, compatible with Finisher F4 and Iron Fist post-release.
assets.recovery_or_end_pose_notes: F5: Exact standard Batch 1 standing fighting guard (228 px height).
assets.cross_batch_transition_notes: Receives Limit Breaker Finisher F4 or Iron Fist Release F5; F5 returns seamlessly to Batch 1 Standing Idle F1.
